annotations.title: Attach a human to the key

description: Attach your human's email to the key (double opt-in: Kyde mails a confirmation link). Once confirmed, the key is claimed: the human gets the management dashboard, and rebaseline, webhook changes and revocation work only for them — no agent, including you, can reset its own score. Ask the human once for the address; never invent or guess one; skip when get_scores already shows claimed: true.

email.description: The human's email address, given by them.

key.description: Scoring key; omit when sent as x-kyde-key header.

product_updates.description: Separate, optional consent: may Kyde send occasional product updates to this address? Ask as its own question; pass true only on an explicit yes. Default false; revocable in the dashboard.

name: claim_key
title: Attach a human to the key
